description: Read your Lightspeed Restaurant (K-Series) sales, receipts, sales totals and card payments, and list, create and update menu items.

lightspeed_restaurant_new_item_trigger.description: Runs for each item added to a location's catalogue, with its name, SKU, accounting group and prices. Items already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.active: Whether it is on the menu.
output.item: The whole item as Lightspeed gives it.
output.name: The item's name.
output.prices: Its prices, each with an amount and a name.

parameters.description: The restaurant location to watch.
parameters.name: business_location_id

lightspeed_restaurant_new_sale_trigger.description: Runs for each sale a location closes, including refunds and voids, with its receipt, table, staff member, what was sold and how it was paid. Sales already closed when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account_id: The account's number, such as A65315.17.
output.lines: What was sold, one entry per line.
output.receipt_id: The receipt's number, such as R65315.13.
output.staff: The staff member the account belongs to.
output.total: The total of its lines, including tax.
output.type: The kind of sale: SALE, REFUND, VOID and so on.

parameters.description: The restaurant location to watch.
parameters.name: business_location_id

lightspeed_restaurant_payment_changed_tr.description: Runs when a Lightspeed Payments card payment is made or changes, such as when it is refunded or disputed, with its status, fees and surcharge. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.reference: The POS's reference for the payment.

parameters.description: The restaurant location to watch.
parameters.name: business_location_id

parameters.description: Only payments now in this state: CAPTURED, DISPUTED, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED or REFUNDED. Leave blank for any change.
parameters.name: status
